# delord.dev

Personal site of Evan DeLord: platform engineer, cloud infrastructure, and a
hobbyist studying what makes AI models tick. The site collects experiments on how AI agents behave (/work), a bio
(/about), and an authorship policy (/authorship) explaining which words are
Evan's and which are AI-written. Static Astro site, no trackers, fonts
self-hosted; source on GitHub (edd426).
Contact and profiles: https://github.com/edd426 and https://www.linkedin.com/in/eddelord.
